# TivaWare (third-party)

TI's TM4C peripheral driver library and chip support files.

## Source

- **Package:** SW-TM4C
- **Version:** 2.2.0.295
- **Obtained:** Downloaded from https://www.ti.com/tool/SW-TM4C
  and extracted with `7z x SW-TM4C-2.2.0.295.exe`.
- **Date pulled:** 2026-05-02

## Files vendored

| File | Origin in TivaWare tree 
|------|------------------------
| `startup_gcc.c` | `examples/boards/ek-tm4c123gxl/blinky/startup_gcc.c`
| `blinky.ld` | `examples/boards/ek-tm4c123gxl/blinky/blinky.ld`
| `tm4c123gh6pm.h` | `inc/tm4c123gh6pm.h`
